token.title: Token address
token.description: The Solana mint or Base ERC-20 address that was checked.

verdict.title: Verdict
verdict.description: SAFE, CAUTION or DANGER. Mapped from the API rating safe / caution / avoid. Null if the check failed.

rating.title: API rating
rating.description: Raw API rating: safe, caution or avoid.

grade.title: Grade
grade.description: A–F letter grade from the token safety check.

score.title: Score
score.description: 0–100 safety score from the token check.

reasons.title: Reasons
reasons.description: Plain-language reasons behind the verdict (mint/freeze authority, LP lock, holders, snipers, sell-route or honeypot flags).

ok.title: Success
ok.description: True when the token verdict was returned. Failed checks are not billed.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error message when the check failed. Null on success.

status.title: HTTP status
status.description: HTTP status from the Trading Signals API for the verdict call.

whaleFlow.title: Whale flow
whaleFlow.description: Optional large DEX buy/sell summary when Include whale flow is on.

preTradePack.title: Pre-trade pack
preTradePack.description: Optional GO / CAUTION / STOP pack when Include pre-trade pack is on.

tokenVerdict.title: Full token verdict
tokenVerdict.description: Full JSON body from GET /solana/token-verdict or GET /base/token-verdict.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per token: rug-check verdict, grade, score and reasons.

details.title: Details
details.description: Full verdict plus any whale-flow or pre-trade pack add-ons.
